newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse holds on to gains in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse holds on to gains in modest trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange rose slightly on Monday after a rebound last week, with gains by a handful of blue chips helping the market to hold firm, traders said.
The GSE All-Share Index edged up 0.77 points to 356.06 with a modest 27,120 shares changing hands, compared with 89,120 shares traded at the last session on Friday.
Among gainers were Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd which advanced 90 cedis to 20,910 cedis, Ghana Commercial Bank Ltd, up five cedis to 655 and Kumasi Brewery Ltd, which added 10 cedis to 710.
